- On the free plan, images come out at 640×640 px. That size works for many listings, but some marketplaces ask for 1000 px or more.
- The links stop working after 24 hours, so please download the images soon.

If any image changed your bottle or isn't quite right, tell me which one and what's wrong. I'll redo just that one (5 credits each).
